title: feat: refine account app connections
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refines the Account connect section with clearer hierarchy, compact connected cards, and responsive discovery controls
- Uses Composio toolkit metadata so connected and available apps show their correct logos on theme-safe tiles
- Uses shared UI components and adds a reusable trash icon for the account deletion footer
- Adds connector metadata coverage and updates the Account integration contract

Tests:
- `npm test` in `packages/ui`
- `npm test` in `apps/composio-mcp`
- `npx vitest run test/integration/integrations.test.ts` in `enter.pollinations.ai`
- UI and Enter TypeScript checks
- `npm run build:frontend` in `enter.pollinations.ai`

gist.headline: The app garden got labels
gist.blurb: Account connections have been given a proper little tidy-up. Connected apps are more compact, new ones are easier to discover, and every tile finally knows which logo it is supposed to be wearing.
gist.summary: Refined the Account connect section with clearer hierarchy, compact connected-app cards, responsive discovery controls, and theme-safe app logos sourced from Composio toolkit metadata.
gist.impact: Users can scan connected and available integrations more easily across screen sizes, with correct app branding on every connection tile.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a cozy garden of integration tiles: tidy connected-app pots on one side and a responsive discovery shelf of new app seedlings on the other, each carrying a distinct logo badge. A helpful CRT monitor robot can sort the tiles while Polli, wearing a tiny gardener apron, checks that every app has the right label; include flowers and code-vines to make the account dashboard feel organized but alive.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee with black oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light-blue translucent wings, antennae, and a small smile, wearing a tiny gardener apron while arranging compact app-logo tiles in a blooming integration garden; a cute CRT monitor robot carefully sorts connected pots from a shelf of newly discovered app seedlings. Soft lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream pastel gradient background, code-vines and tiny flowers, pixel-font sign reading "CONNECTED APPS"; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
